riskAssessment.reason: V2 adds persistent source-bound provenance and versions beside valid V1 behavior; schema and CLI regressions could invalidate stored snapshots.

preReviewWarnings: Review V1 compatibility, source digest validation, version monotonicity, and unchanged rebuild stability.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: A V2 snapshot represents source-bound facts with typed subject and sourceRef fields, and source paths/digests are validated before the fact contributes to V2 governance projection.

Persisted V2 versions are unchanged by a rebuild with an unchanged projection; a governance-visible fact increments governance/source sequencing only, while a runtime-only observation increments runtime observation only.
Missing, unreadable, or digest-mismatched authoritative source evidence produces explicit inconsistent V2 output without silently claiming a valid governance state.
Explicit --schema-version 1 keeps valid V1 response behavior; --schema-version 2 selects the additive V2 serializer, schema, and CLI behavior.
Focused and full WIII unit/integration tests, schema validation, documentation metadata, required governance checks, ai-finish/archive, hosted PR checks, merge, and ai-close-work-item pass.
guidelines: New public APIs must be documented.
Do not import internal modules from other features.

intent.problem: WIII V1 stores facts without source-bound validation and fixes statusVersion at 1, so consumers cannot detect governance evidence changes or distinguish governance from runtime observation changes. Implement the first compatible V2 foundation without claiming scheduler or remote orchestration capabilities.
constraints: Use test-first development and preserve valid V1 fact/snapshot behavior behind explicit schema-version selection.
Source evidence must be local, typed, path- and digest-bound; an unavailable or mismatched source is inconsistent rather than silently trusted.
Do not implement later plan tasks such as keyed open-entity semantics, global index/cache redesign, timing, receipt reuse, or verification routing.
Use the direct user approval recorded below only for this Work Item's PR/merge and governed ai-close-work-item branch cleanup.
intent.rationale: A source-bound V2 serializer and meaningful persisted counters establish the integrity and compatibility contract that later reducer and publication work depends on.
